question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
WITH seller_product_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_items_sold
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),

seller_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN seller_product_qty spq ON oi.seller_id = spq.seller_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),

seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(orv.review_score) AS avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    INNER JOIN seller_product_qty spq ON oi.seller_id = spq.seller_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),

seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(
            date_diff('day', CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP))
        ) AS avg_packing_time_days
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN seller_product_qty spq ON oi.seller_id = spq.seller_id
    WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL 
      AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),

seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pct.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) AS category_sales
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    INNER JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
    INNER JOIN seller_product_qty spq ON oi.seller_id = spq.seller_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pct.product_category_name_english
),

seller_top_category AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            seller_id,
            product_category_name_english,
            category_sales,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) AS rn
        FROM seller_category_sales
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT 
    spq.seller_id,
    ROUND(ss.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
    ROUND(ss.avg_item_price, 2) AS avg_item_price,
    ROUND(sr.avg_review_score, 2) AS avg_review_score,
    ROUND(sp.avg_packing_time_days, 2) AS avg_packing_time_days,
    stc.product_category_name_english AS top_category
FROM seller_product_qty spq
INNER JOIN seller_sales ss ON spq.seller_id = ss.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON spq.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing sp ON spq.seller_id = sp.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_top_category stc ON spq.seller_id = stc.seller_id
ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC;

seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(
            CAST((julianday(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - julianday(o.order_approved_at)) AS DOUBLE)
        ) AS avg_packing_time_days
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN seller_product_qty spq ON oi.seller_id = spq.seller_id
    WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL 
      AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id

seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pct.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) AS category_sales
    FROM order_items oi
